description: What a FEMA flood zone code means and its flood insurance rules: A, AE, AH, AO, AR, A99, V, VE, shaded X (old B, 0.2% annual chance), unshaded X (old C), D. Omit the zone for the full list. No address needed.

subtype.description: Optional zone subtype from a map, e.g. "FLOODWAY" or "0.2 PCT ANNUAL CHANCE FLOOD HAZARD".

zone.description: Zone code, e.g. AE, VE, X, "shaded X", B, C, D. Omit for every zone.

name: flood_zone_explain
title: What a flood zone means
